name: MsoCommandBarButtonHyperlinkType
description: Specifies whether the command bar button is a hyperlink. If the command bar button is a hyperlink, further specifies whether the hyperlink should launch another application such as the browser or insert a picture at the active selection point.

constants.name: msoCommandBarButtonHyperlinkNone
constants.description: The command bar button is not a hyperlink.

constants.name: msoCommandBarButtonHyperlinkOpen
constants.description: Clicking the command bar button opens the link specified in the command bar button's TooltipText property.

constants.name: msoCommandBarButtonHyperlinkInsertPicture
constants.description: Clicking the command bar button inserts a picture at the active selection point.
